evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented distinction enacts market-pricing: intelligence framed as property whose form of acquisition (own vs. rent) changes its value.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Calling perspective an 'asset you keep' performs proportionality — value accrues differentially to the owner, a cost/benefit framing of what is worth retaining.
Naming a 'thesis' positions the claim within a market of ideas where ownership of intelligence is the contested proposition — proportionality framing of intellectual property.
